sourceTitle: Tamil Nadu Standard Ten Mathematics, English revised 2025, Chapter 2
scope: 53 canonical source-text-checked question records plus 10 unique supplementary parts; ambiguity and incomplete inventory remain held.

records.label: Exercise 2.3 · Q5
records.question: What is the time 100 hours after 7 a.m.?

records.label: Exercise 2.3 · Q6
records.question: What is the time 15 hours before 11 p.m.?

records.label: Exercise 2.3 · Q7
records.question: Today is Tuesday. My uncle will come after 45 days. On which day will he come?

records.label: Exercise 2.3 · Q10
records.question: A flight from Chennai to London takes approximately 11 hours. It leaves on Sunday at 23:30 hours. Chennai is 4½ hours ahead of London. Find the London arrival day and time.
records.answer: Monday, 6:00 a.m. London time, using the textbook's fixed 4½-hour time difference.

records.label: Exercise 2.4 · Q1
records.question: Find the next three terms: (i) 8, 24, 72, … (ii) 5, 1, −3, … (iii) 1/4, 2/9, 3/16, …

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q4
records.question: Find the 19th term of the A.P. −11, −15, −19, …

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q5
records.question: Which term of the A.P. 16, 11, 6, 1, … is −54?

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q6
records.question: Find the middle term(s) of the A.P. 9, 15, 21, 27, …, 183.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q7
records.question: If nine times the 9th term of an A.P. equals fifteen times its 15th term, show that six times the 24th term is zero.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q9
records.question: Find x, y and z if x, 10, y, 24, z are in A.P.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q10
records.question: A theatre has 20 seats in its front row and 30 rows. Each next row has 2 more seats. How many seats are in the last row?

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q11
records.question: The sum of three consecutive terms in A.P. is 27 and their product is 288. Find the three terms.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q12
records.question: The ratio of the 6th to the 8th term of an A.P. is 7:9. Find the ratio of the 9th to the 13th term.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q13
records.question: The temperatures from Monday to Friday are in A.P. The Monday–Wednesday sum is 0°C and the Wednesday–Friday sum is 18°C. Find each day's temperature.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q14
records.question: Priya earns ₹15,000 monthly at first, increasing ₹1,500 annually. Her initial monthly expenses are ₹13,000, increasing ₹900 annually. When can she save ₹20,000 each month?

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q1
records.question: Find (i) the sum of 3, 7, 11, … up to 40 terms and (ii) the sum of 102, 97, 92, … up to 27 terms.

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q2
records.question: How many consecutive odd integers, beginning with 5, sum to 480?

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q5
records.question: The 104th term and 4th term of an A.P. are 125 and 0. Find the sum of its first 35 terms.

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q6
records.question: Find the sum of all odd positive integers less than 450.

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q7
records.question: Find the sum of all natural numbers between 602 and 902 which are not divisible by 4.

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q8
records.question: A laptop costs ₹40,000 in cash or 10 instalments starting ₹4,800, decreasing by ₹50 each month. Find (i) total instalments and (ii) extra cost.

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q9
records.question: A man repays ₹65,000 starting with ₹400 the first month, increasing each monthly payment by ₹300. After how many months is the loan cleared?

records.label: Exercise 2.6 · Q10
records.question: A staircase has 30 steps. The bottom needs 100 bricks and each higher step needs 2 fewer. Find (i) bricks at the top and (ii) the total bricks.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q2
records.question: Write the first three G.P. terms when (i) a=6, r=3 (ii) a=2, r=2 (iii) a=1000, r=2/5.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q3
records.question: In the G.P. 729, 243, 81, … find the seventh term.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q4
records.question: Find x so that x+6, x+12, x+15 are consecutive terms in a G.P.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q5
records.question: Find the number of terms of (i) 4, 8, 16, …, 8192 and (ii) 1/3, 1/9, 1/27, …, 1/2187.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q6
records.question: In a G.P., the ninth term is 32805 and sixth is 1215. Find the twelfth term.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q7
records.question: Find the 10th term of a G.P. whose eighth term is 768 and ratio is 2.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q8
records.question: If a, b, c are in arithmetic progression, show that 3ᵃ, 3ᵇ, 3ᶜ are in geometric progression.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q11
records.question: Offer A starts at ₹20,000 with a 6% annual rise; Offer B starts at ₹22,000 with a 3% rise. Find the fourth-year salaries.
records.answer: Offer A: ₹23,820.32; Offer B: about ₹24,039.39; Offer B is larger.

records.label: Exercise 2.8 · Q2
records.question: Find the sum of the first six terms of the G.P. 5, 15, 45, …

records.question: Find the first term of a G.P. with common ratio 5 and sum of the first six terms 46872.

records.label: Exercise 2.8 · Q4
records.question: Find the infinite sums of (i) 9+3+1+… and (ii) 21+14+28/3+…

records.label: Exercise 2.8 · Q5

records.label: Exercise 2.8 · Q7
records.question: Find the sum 3+6+12+…+1536.

records.label: Exercise 2.9 · Q4
records.question: How many terms of 1³+2³+3³+… have sum 14400?

records.label: Exercise 2.9 · Q5
records.question: The sum of cubes of the first n natural numbers is 2025. Find n.

records.label: Exercise 2.9 · Q6
records.question: Rekha has 15 square sheets with side lengths 10 cm, 11 cm, …, 24 cm. Find the total area.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q1
records.question: Which inequality must the remainder r satisfy in Euclid's division lemma for positive a and b? Options: (A) 1<r<b (B) 0<r<b (C) 0≤r<b (D) 0<r≤b.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q2
records.question: Possible remainders when the cube of a positive integer is divided by 9: (A) 0,1,8 (B) 1,4,8 (C) 0,1,3 (D) 1,3,5.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q3
records.question: HCF(65,117) is expressible as 65m−117. Find m. Options: (A) 4 (B) 2 (C) 1 (D) 3.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q4
records.question: The sum of the exponents of prime factors in 1729 is: (A) 1 (B) 2 (C) 3 (D) 4.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q5
records.question: The least positive number divisible by every number 1 through 10 is: (A) 2025 (B) 5220 (C) 5025 (D) 2520.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q7
records.question: Given F₁=1, F₂=3 and Fₙ=Fₙ₋₁+Fₙ₋₂, find F₅. Options: (A)3 (B)5 (C)8 (D)11.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q8
records.question: An A.P. starts at 1 with common difference 4. Which is a term: (A)4551 (B)10091 (C)7881 (D)13531?

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q9
records.question: If six times the 6th A.P. term equals seven times the 7th, find the 13th term. Options: (A)0 (B)6 (C)7 (D)13.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q10
records.question: An A.P. has 31 terms and the 16th term is m. Its sum is: (A)16m (B)62m (C)31m (D)31m/2.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q11
records.question: An A.P. begins at 1 and has common difference 4. How many terms have sum 120? Options: (A)6 (B)7 (C)8 (D)9.

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q12
records.question: Let A = 2⁶⁵ and B = 2⁶⁴ + 2⁶³ + 2⁶² + … + 2⁰. Which is larger and by how much?
records.answer: A is larger than B by 1 (option D).

records.label: Exercise 2.10 · Q14
records.question: If t₁,t₂,t₃,… form an A.P., what type of sequence is t₆,t₁₂,t₁₈,…? Options include A.P., G.P. and neither.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q1(ii)
records.question: Check whether the sequence 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5, … is in A.P.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q1(iii)
records.question: Check whether 9, 13, 17, 21, 25, … is in A.P.
records.answer: Yes, it is an A.P. with common difference 4.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q1(iv)
records.question: Check whether −1/3, 0, 1/3, 2/3, … is in A.P.
records.answer: Yes, an A.P. with common difference 1/3.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q2(i)
records.question: The first term a = 5 and common difference d = 6. Find the corresponding A.P.

records.label: Exercise 2.5 · Q2(ii)
records.question: The first term a = 7 and common difference d = −5. Find the corresponding A.P.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q1(i)
records.question: Which of the following sequences are in G.P.? (i) 3, 9, 27, 81, …
records.answer: Yes, it is a G.P.; common ratio 3.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q1(ii)
records.question: Which of the following sequences are in G.P.? (ii) 4, 44, 444, 4444, …
records.answer: No, this is not a G.P.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q1(iii)
records.question: Which of the following sequences are in G.P.? (iii) 0.5, 0.05, 0.005, …
records.answer: Yes, it is a G.P. with common ratio 1/10.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q1(iv)
records.question: Which of the following sequences are in G.P.? (iv) 1/3, 1/6, 1/12, …
records.answer: Yes, it is a G.P. with common ratio 1/2.

records.label: Exercise 2.7 · Q1(vi)
records.question: Which of the following sequences are in G.P.? (vi) 120, 60, 30, 18, …
records.answer: No, it is not a G.P.
